title: Sentinel
tagline: Stop-loss for your entire portfolio. Sentinel auto-exits to stables when risk hits.
description: Sentinel is a DeFi stop-loss agent for your whole portfolio and Uniswap LP positions. It watches pool health, token prices, depegs, and exploit intel (The Graph, Blockaid/X), scores risk with 0G Compute, then auto-exits: withdraw LP → swap to USDC/USDT/DAI → transfer to a safe wallet in case of protocol hacks or compromises. Policy thresholds live in a dashboard; a bot runs the always-on scanner and panic worker against shared Redis. Public demo at sentinel-lisbon.vercel.app runs dry-run triggers so anyone can fire an incident and see the live agent feed without shipping private keys.
auto_summary: A TypeScript monorepo for monitoring DeFi portfolio risk and triggering Uniswap-based LP exits and stablecoin swaps.
